verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party feature pages describe custom automations and rules that move work forward, including Rovo AI-assisted rule creation. They also describe automation that connects tools like Bitbucket and Slack to Jira workflows to keep Jira up to date automatically. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on event triggers, conditions and actions (event-driven firing is implied rather than detailed), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation engine.
